title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1972-12-31
source: Recording of FM Broadcast on KSAN > ? > DAT provided and transferred by Stuccoholmes; Mastering & Editing by Jason Chastain in Audition CC 2015; Final Mastering by Jamie Waddell in Wavelab 7.1; Track, FLAC and Pack by Norm

ai_review.summary: Unique Winterland recording with an extended, high‑energy Other One and magnificent Morning Dew, but limited info on audio fidelity.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the marathon late‑night jam – a sizzling Truckin' segue into an essential, extended Other One and a magnificent Morning Dew – while noting the melancholy vibe of a Pigpen‑less show. The only technical note is that this source uniquely captures the infamous “putz” moment from the rafters; no clear sound quality issues are reported.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical praise (5‑star review) balanced by a zero‑star, humor‑laden rating and no concrete recording quality data; overall the show is regarded as high‑energy with an average to good listening experience.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit soundboard or audience comments; reviewers highlight that this may be the only source capturing the "putz" incident, suggesting a unique but otherwise acceptable capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Late‑night marathon with high energy extending past 4 am; the show builds into a massive Other One sequence and keeps the party going.

band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann is noted for scolding the "putz" who was coaxed down from the rafters.
